summary: Re-review after fixes. All 19 original issues were checked against the re-exported packets and every one is fixed in substance: the cirrhosis hook now includes portal hypertension, acid-base compensation is qualified (with a cross-reference to altitude), q009 and q001 acid-base stems no longer copy the lesson, fluid q007 and q009 are corrected, the ECG hyperkalaemia cross-reference is gone, the action potential gap and duration figures are corrected, the breath-holding spell wording is accurate, the COPD oxygen item is now multi-mechanism and hedged, and the repeated worked-example stems (transplant, complete heart block, gain) were replaced with different scenarios. All numeric keys in the 12 changed units were recomputed (Henderson-Hasselbalch, Nernst, Starling, Fick, osmolarity, sodium handling, gain, CO) and all MCQ, true-false and theory keys were solved; no wrong key, multi-correct MCQ or explanation contradiction was found. Only minor residuals remain: unit objectives were not widened to match content that is now taught in the lessons, and one theory stem still mirrors its hook. This is an AI review only: the course still needs a subject-matter expert before clinical reliance.

issues.problem: Stem (35-year-old woman with primary adrenal insufficiency, low blood pressure, low sodium, high potassium) is essentially the lesson hook restated, so the answer is largely handed over. The non-osmotic ADH and cortisol material is now taught, so the earlier level issue is resolved.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the patient or add a twist, for example a different age and a request to predict what happens to urine sodium and plasma renin.

issues.problem: Filtered sodium load and fraction reabsorbed is now taught in the lesson but none of the three unit objectives names it (q007 is tagged to the aldosterone objective).
issues.suggestedFix: Add a short objective on filtered load and fraction reabsorbed, or retag q007; low priority now that the lesson covers it.

issues.problem: Viscosity and series/parallel resistance (q007, q008) are now taught in the lesson but no objective covers them, and q007 is tagged to the radius objective.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an objective for viscosity and series/parallel resistance, or retag q007 to the pressure-flow-resistance objective.

issues.problem: Minute ventilation (rate x tidal volume) is now taught but still tagged to the brainstem-rhythm objective; no objective covers minute ventilation. The numbers no longer repeat the opioid worked example.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a minute-ventilation objective or retag; low priority.

issues.problem: Oxygen content and oxygen unloading (q003, q008) are now taught in the lesson, but the objectives still mention only diffusion, V/Q mismatch and the dissociation curve. The altitude marking-guide point was removed from q009 as requested.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an objective on oxygen content and oxygen delivery or retag q003 and q008 to the dissociation-curve objective; low priority.

issues.problem: q004 (MCQ) and q010 (theory) both ask about the same post-meal glucose loop already mapped in the lesson table, and q007 adds a glucose gain calculation; three items on one scenario with q004 and q010 near-duplicates.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a different regulated variable in q010 (for example arterial pressure via the baroreceptor reflex or plasma calcium).
